title: Eggplant and Kashkaval Burekas
subtitle: with ready-made pilas pastry
description: Quick triangle burekas of pilas pastry filled with fire-roasted eggplant, fried onion and kashkaval. Serve hot with hard-boiled eggs, olives and cucumbers.

steps.text: Char the eggplants over an open flame for a few minutes on each side until blackened and soft. Cool for 10-15 minutes, peel and drain the flesh in a sieve for about 1 hour.
Roughly chop the eggplant flesh and place in a bowl.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add the olive oil and finely chopped onion and fry for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft. Cool well.
Add the onion and its oil to the eggplant. Add the coarsely grated kashkaval, season with a little salt and pepper and mix.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and line 3 trays with baking paper.

Spread out the pastry with the plastic side down. Cut across into 12 strips 8 cm wide, then cut each strip into 3 squares to make 36 squares. Place a teaspoon of filling in the centre of each square, close into a triangle and press the edges firmly.
Place on the trays. Beat the egg with the water, brush the pastries and sprinkle with poppy or sesame seeds.
Bake in the hot oven for 20-25 minutes until golden. Serve hot with hard-boiled eggs, olives and cucumbers. Store airtight in the fridge for up to 3 days and reheat at 170°C for a few minutes.
